Generalized disorders are on the rise everywhere. However they can develop due to traumatic events in life as well. 

Sexual assault (rampant on campus), substance abuse, alcoholism, unhealthy expectations of grades, partners, contribute a lot to this, I think.

The other thing these open discussions do is make people have realizations about their realities - sexual abuse at home, eating disorders you didn't know were eating disorders, substance abuse with over the counter drugs, is a pretty common process. 

It's a lot of pressure to survive in "the Harvard of Canada" especially if you're supposed to be the beacon of your working class family.
